import CategoryTheory.Homotopy
import CategoryTheory.Abelian
import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.VerdierLocalizing

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] :
  (HomotopyCategory.plus C).IsVerdierRightLocalizing (HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C) := by
  let H := HomotopyCategory.plus C
  let A := HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C

  have h_closed_under_isomorphisms : A.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms :=
    HomotopyCategory.instIsClosedUnderIsomorphismsIntUpSubcategoryAcyclic C

  have h_thick : A.IsThick := by
    refine ⟨fun X Y => _, fun X Y => _⟩
    · intro hX hY
      obtain ⟨Z, a, b, hZ, hA⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff C X).mp hX
      obtain ⟨Z', a', b', hZ', hB⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff C Y).mp hY
      let Z'' := Z ⊕ Z'
      let a'' : X ⟶ Z'' := (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C).map (a ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.prodInl _)
      let b'' : Z'' ⟶ Y := (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C).map (b' ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.prodInr _)
      have hZ'' : ∀ n, CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C).obj (Z'') n) :=
        fun n => (CategoryTheory.Limits.isZeroOfIsZeroProduct (hZ n) (hZ' n))
      exact ⟨Z'', a'', b'', hZ'', hA⟩
    · intro hX
      obtain ⟨Z, a, b, hZ, hA⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff C X).mp hX
      let Z' := Z
      let a' : X ⟶ Z' := a
      let b' : Z' ⟶ X := b
      have hZ' : ∀ n, CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C).obj (Z') n) :=
        fun n => hZ n
      exact ⟨Z', a', b', hZ', hA⟩

  have h_orthogonal : A.IsOrthogonalRight (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C) := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    obtain ⟨Z, a, b, hZ, hA⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff C X).mp hX
    obtain ⟨Z', a', b', hZ', hB⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff C Y).mp hY
    let f : X ⟶ Y := a ≫ b'
    have hf : ∀ n, CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor C).obj (f n)) :=
      fun n => (CategoryTheory.Limits.isZeroOfIsZeroComposition (hZ n) (hZ' n))
    exact hf

  have h_localizing : A.IsVerdierRightLocalizing := by
    refine (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsVerdierRightLocalizing.mk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _......
